page_title: NAP 2-1 JUV | Napoli v Juventus 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' A yellow card for a tackle by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus). Daniele Chiffi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+5' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+4' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+4' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Weston McKennie (Juventus) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Napoli earn a free kick.
90+2' We are about to witness a substitution. Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) is replacing David Neres.
90+1' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sees a yellow card from Daniele Chiffi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Romelu Lukaku and he is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
89' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Stanislav Lobotka walks off the pitch to be replaced by Billy Gilmour (Napoli).

89' It looks like Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Chiffi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Juventus, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
88' Juan Jesus (Napoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
87' Juan Jesus (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
86' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Napoli have been awarded a free kick.
83' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Napoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
82' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Matteo Politano will be replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
82' Substitution. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) in, Randal Kolo Muani out.
80' Napoli are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
78' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

78' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Napoli.
77' Half-chance! Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) plays a pass into the box, but Alex Meret reacts well to snuff out the attack.
76' One of the players from Napoli times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
74' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) replacing Nicolas Gonzalez.
74' Manuel Locatelli comes off the pitch to be replaced by Douglas Luiz (Juventus).
72' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
72' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
69' 2 - 1 Goal! Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Michele Di Gregorio to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
69' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

68' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Napoli are awarded a penalty.
67' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli win a free kick.

66' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
66' David Neres (Napoli) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

66' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.
66' Surely that's handball by one of the Juventus players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
65' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Nicolo Savona (Juventus) replaces Andrea Cambiaso.
65' A substitution has been made. Kenan Yildiz goes off and Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) comes on.

64' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul. Napoli win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
64' Matteo Politano (Napoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
63' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by David Neres (Napoli).
63' David Neres (Napoli) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
63' A lofted pass picks out Matteo Politano (Napoli) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender. Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.
61' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
59' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) trips an opposition player and Daniele Chiffi signals a foul. Napoli get a free kick.
57' 1 - 1 Goal! Matteo Politano swings the ball deep into the box and finds Frank Anguissa (Napoli) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the left side of the goal. 1:1.

55' Matteo Politano (Napoli) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
54' The referee blows his whistle as Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) was too aggressive in his challenge. Napoli have a free kick.
53' Federico Gatti (Juventus) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli are awarded a free kick.
52' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul. Juventus have a free kick.
51' The resulting corner from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared.
51' Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Napoli get a corner.
51' A corner kick by Napoli is thwarted by the well prepared Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus).

50' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Michele Di Gregorio, who pulls off a stunning save! Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
50' An attempted cross from Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is cleared.
48' Scott McTominay (Napoli) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Daniele Chiffi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' Matteo Politano (Napoli) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) has too much to say to the referee and receives a yellow card.
45' Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus). A free kick has been awarded to Napoli.
43' 0 - 1 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
43' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
41' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
41' The ball goes out of play and Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.

41' David Neres (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.

40' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Chiffi with no other option than to blow for a foul. Napoli have a free kick.

39' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
38' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Juventus.
36' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Meret comes off his line to gather the ball.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.

36' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Juventus force a corner. They send men into the box.
35' Rough tackle by Scott McTominay (Napoli). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Juventus.
32' Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game. One of the players from Napoli won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Juventus in a dangerous position.
31' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) brings an opponent down and Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game. Napoli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
30' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
29' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
28' The game is interrupted now, Frank Anguissa (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Juventus keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
24' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

23' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Daniele Chiffi saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Napoli, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
21' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
20' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
20' Matteo Politano (Napoli) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the crossbar and wastes a promising chance.

18' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
18' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
18' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball is out of play and Napoli manage to earn a corner.

17' The game is interrupted. Juan Jesus (Napoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Juventus will take a free kick.
15' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle and it's Matteo Politano (Napoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Juventus are awarded the free kick.
14' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
13' A cross into the box from David Neres (Napoli) is cleared.
12' Matteo Politano (Napoli) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
10' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
10' Juventus are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
6' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Alex Meret is alert and denies him.
4' Matteo Politano (Napoli) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
3' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Napoli have a corner.
1' Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi will supervise the game today.
